component.name: KMark
component.summary: Native WYSIWYG Markdown and plain-text editor for KDE Plasma
Nativer WYSIWYG-Markdown- und Texteditor für KDE Plasma

description.p: KMark combines distraction-free WYSIWYG Markdown typography with the speed, reliability, and native look-and-feel of KDE Plasma (Qt6 / KDE Frameworks 6). A memory-safe Rust engine (piece/chunk Rope + incremental CommonMark/GFM parser + virtualized 2D viewport layout) renders documents of 100,000+ lines without browser/Electron overhead.

KMark verbindet ablenkungsfreie WYSIWYG-Markdown-Typografie mit der Geschwindigkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und nativen Integration von KDE Plasma (Qt6 / KDE Frameworks 6). Eine speichersichere Rust-Engine (Rope-Textpuffer + inkrementeller CommonMark/GFM-Parser + virtualisiertes 2D-Layout) verarbeitet selbst Dokumente mit über 100.000 Zeilen verzögerungsfrei.

ul.li: Four seamless view modes: Formatted (WYSIWYG), Live Preview, Markdown Source, and Plain Text (TXT)
True 2D GFM table editing with contextual table toolbar, smart column balancing, and Tab/Shift+Tab navigation
Six curated Appearance Presets (Breeze, Modern, Classic, Calm, Dark, Technical), custom presets, and unified Settings dialog
Clickable code block language badge, Callout type switcher, and interactive task list checkboxes
Inline images with captions, relative percentage sizing, drag & drop, and right-click image context menu
Automatic KDE/system locale detection (English & German), Quick Reference (F1), and Complete Markdown Reference (Shift+F1)

description.p: Open files as tabs in the already-running KMark window by default (with -n/--new-window override, taskbar New Window action, and Settings toggle).
Initial public release of KMark for Linux and KDE Plasma.
